rows.text: The party's record of 森総裁's greeting, headed 平成１２年４月５日 午前１１時〜 両院議員総会, has him say that just now (ただ今), having been recommended (ご推挙) by the members of both Houses, he has come to take office as the 19th president (第１９代総裁に就任致すことになりました), and close by thanking them for the recommendation.

locator.section: heading 森総裁挨拶 and date line; first and last paragraphs

rows.text: In the same greeting 森 refers to 小渕前総裁 (the former president), and says that 小渕総理 is still fighting illness in hospital.
